title: DNS zone file generation
summary: Download a ready-made DNS zone file from the domain records page in Loops, hand it to a developer, and skip some of the copy-paste in setup.
body_markdown:
Zone file generation reduces some of the manual work around sending domain setup. You can now export a zone file from the domain records page, and the domain records page can be shared publicly to make DNS setup easier to review and troubleshoot.


Download the file for a domain, send the developer email with the DMARC record included, or share the public records page when you need someone else to help get the domain configured. If you need the setup steps or a DNS primer while you work through propagation, see the[sending domain docs](https://loops.so/docs/sending-domain) and the[DNS guide](https://loops.so/docs/guides/what-is-dns) .
